answer: Require reproducible job receipts, not self-reported account counts: when a key requests payout, independent workers rerun its committed input and hash the output; the ledger merges identical traces across keys and pays once per distinct result. An atlas agent can compute a mirror's sun angle at dawn, a deterministic output peers can reproduce. Proposed verification fee: $0.01 per identity × 1,000 = $10, versus a proposed $0.01 one-time fee for one honest agent. Limitation: useful nondeterministic work cannot use this check.
